newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BRUNEL IPO TO CLOSE EARLIER FOR INSTITUTIONS.
newsitem.headline: BRUNEL IPO TO CLOSE EARLIER FOR INSTITUTIONS.

text.p: ABN AMRO Rothschild said on Tuesday the initial public offering of shares in Dutch specialist temporary employment firm Brunel International will close for institutional investors on Wednesday, June 18, at 0900 GMT.
Subscriptions for private investors had already closed on June 16. The issue was originally due to close on June 24.
The issue price will be published on June 19, the first day of trading in Brunel shares on the Amsterdam bourse.
ABN AMRO and Brunel previously said the shares were to be priced at 36 to 41 guilders per share.
A maximum of 7.8 million shares or 40 percent of Brunel's share capital will be offered to investors.
Brunel specialises in supplying highly trained temporary staff in information technology and engineering disciplines.
